Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; keeping right, left-half use, passing right, one-way and lane rules resolve to the first selected page, following, divided highways, signals and railroad crossings to the second, speed and the first parking list to the third, the remaining parking rules, tow-away zones, interference, unattended vehicles, emergency vehicles and processions to the fourth, the emblem and the first no-passing situations to the fifth, the remaining no-passing situations to the sixth, and the right-of-way rules to the seventh.

Confidence: high across the section; every rule is stated directly on its page. The no-passing and right-of-way pages pair each rule with a diagram, and the statements here restate the printed captions, not the pictures. Metric equivalents printed beside the distances are omitted from the statements because the test values are stated in feet and inches.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.
